svg.title: DFM vs LSTM Nowcasting
svg.desc: The DFM cleans up gaps and frequencies into trainable monthly data; the LSTM learns the nonlinear relations from it.
svg.text: DFM vs LSTM — two pillars of nowcasting
A model that fills gaps and extracts factors vs one that learns nonlinear relations from that data
Extract a common factor per block
the values available at that date
The monthly data from here becomes the next stage's input
The same architecture is retrained each quarter
The linear structure makes the result easy to explain
Lower error across the whole range
The gap widened the more uncertain the period
Not rivals but a division of labor — the DFM solves the data problem, the LSTM the nonlinearity.
Over 2017:Q1-2021:Q3 both models caught the turning points early.
Because the DFM even produces monthly GDP growth, the LSTM gets trainable data.
Concept after Yi, Choi and Kim (2022), Bank of Korea Economic Analysis 28(2) — figures illustrative.
